 About this edition

A clearer way through the guide.

Content
Instruction wording and prerequisites are retained from Word. Annotated screenshots are rendered from the supplied PDF. Classroom administration is omitted; useful knowledge checks are available in Practice.

Search covers the retained user guide, references, and Practice section. The separate Production Execution Workbench guides were not supplied; their references remain visible.
